entries.text: Added 100 transparent Watchdog-derived markers, ten for each of ten professional audiences, with formula, professional reason, access tier and dependency-refresh contract. The governed marker catalog now contains 543 fields, including 218 proprietary Watchdog signals. Added a staging-only, browser-level anonymous access smoke test that refuses the production domain. Mobile navigation now uses a clean More sheet with grouped workspace, research and account destinations, large touch targets, safe-area handling, keyboard dismissal, focus visibility and reduced-motion support.

entries.text: Added 154 governed Pro+ markers from eleven high-value statewide DCA and NJDEP source families: raw parcel-linked permits, development trends, new-home warranties, municipal housing profiles, affordable-housing monitoring, community assets, zoning-directory links, PILOT forecasts, MOD-IV longitudinal history, neighborhood trends and contaminated-site remediation data. The governed catalog now contains 697 markers, including 262 transparent Watchdog-derived signals. entries.text: BatchData's current developer documentation describes property lookup and search, ownership and mortgage details, transaction history, permits, property monitoring, skip tracing, phone verification, DNC and TCPA screening, address services and batch APIs. That breadth is valuable for national applications. Watchdog's advantage is different: it organizes New Jersey-specific public evidence and checked calculated intelligence around how NJ professionals actually evaluate properties.

entries.text: Built Stripe Checkout, Customer Portal and signed subscription-webhook code; moved paid-plan reads toward server entitlements; added Pro+ RLS-protected saved Data Center views; launched the developer-only 342-marker refresh-control center and six-hour NJ publisher-change monitoring; added Account & Billing, Terms, Privacy and Data Methodology; and repositioned Watchdog as the product publisher instead of personal developer branding.

entries.text: Built the first governed statewide ingestion layer for Watchdog. The 2026 Treasury MOD-IV archive validates across all 21 county partitions with 3,208,097 source records and zero structural failures, then normalizes only approved property/tax fields into Git-ignored work products. Added a privacy-limited live connector for NJGIN's current statewide parcel service, whose validation run reports 3,478,727 parcel geometries with all 38 approved fields present and zero forbidden owner/mailing fields requested. Registered the July 2026 DCA Data Hub inventory as the acquisition map, added daily live-source contract checks, and surfaced the complete review gate in developer-only Data Operations. No validated source automatically becomes customer-facing data.

entries.text: Built the first provider-neutral paid control plane around Paddle with authenticated server-created transactions, temporary Customer Portal sessions, signed webhook verification, idempotent/out-of-order event handling and server-authoritative Pro/Pro+ route enforcement. Upgraded Property Pulse into Change Intelligence with date/type filtering, sourced change deltas and trusted Watchdog Score history while removing customer browser writes to score evidence. Shipped the Pro Watchdog Workbench for private property case files, notes, status, marker pins, dated snapshots, exports and activity history, and connected Evidence Graph 2.0 to the case/change workflow. Added customer-owned profession personalization that changes recommendations without changing entitlement.

entries.text: Watchdog Analytics is developer-only and aggregate-first. Event rows use audience classes rather than identities. It does not expose names, emails, addresses, PAMS PINs, search text, prompts, phone numbers or IP addresses. Signup acquisition links a newly created account to a consented anonymous Watchdog visitor/session, provider and sanitized first-touch metadata. entries.text: Zillow says its Zestimate is a model-based estimate of a home's market value using public records, MLS data and user-submitted details. Zillow also says it is not an appraisal. In New Jersey, an assessed value is part of the local tax system. Comparing the two numbers directly without the municipality's common level ratio can create a false impression that a property is over- or under-assessed.
